text: …　なにか　つれたかって？

structure.jp: …　なにか　つれたかって？

patterns.name: 〜って (quoting)
patterns.explanation: って is the casual way to repeat what someone said or asked. Ending on it with a question tone means 'is that what you are asking?'. つれたかって？ = 'did I catch anything, you ask?'

patterns.name: 〜られる (potential)
patterns.explanation: つる 'to fish' becomes つれる 'to be able to catch'. In the past it is つれた. なにか　つれた = 'managed to catch something'.
